narrative.overview: Modern, dynamic and clean: supplied service artwork, midnight surfaces and soft brand-colour light. The user pinned the spotlight and strip composition; this metaphor describes the implemented palette and depth without claiming an independently approved comp.
keyCharacteristics: Bronze selection and ivory strip focus

rules.name: Selection Key
rules.body: Bronze denotes selection; ivory around a strip item denotes focus.

rules.name: Artwork Identity
rules.body: Preserve supplied service artwork rather than typesetting substitute logos.

dos: Do preserve logo proportions and the white YouTube background.
donts: Don't add greetings, promotional copy, tile numbers or decorative arrows to this launcher.
Don't infer mobile reflow or TV performance guarantees from scaled local previews.
